user.title: Choose your scale
user.description: Pick an Aria Air that Home Assistant can currently see. If none appear, step on the scale and try again.

key.title: Scale key
key.description: Enter the 16-byte key (32 hex characters) that links {name} to its owner. The README explains how to read it from a Bluetooth log of your own Fitbit app setting the scale up.

data_description.key: 32 hex characters. Spaces, colons and dashes are ignored.
data_description.unit: The scale sends a plain number. Pick the unit its display shows.

error.invalid_key: That is not a valid 16-byte hex key.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this scale is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No Aria Air was found. Step on the scale, make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range, and try again.

data_description.unit: Pick the unit the scale's display shows.
data_description.always_connect: Try to connect every 15 seconds while the scale is in range. Turn this on if weigh-ins are missed, which is common with Bluetooth proxies. It keeps a Bluetooth connection slot busy.
